title: Quick Deep-Fried American Chicken Noodles
description: A simple and satisfying American dish featuring vermicelli rice noodles, crispy deep-fried chicken, and a hint of savory flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add egg and buttermilk to the flour mixture, whisking until smooth.
Add soy sauce and whisk until combined.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and coat evenly with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together bread crumbs and a pinch of paprika.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and coat evenly with the bread crumb mixture.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or deep fryer to 350°F.
Fry the chicken in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 5-7 minutes per batch.
Drain the fried chicken on paper towels and keep warm.
Cook the vermicelli rice noodles according to package instructions.
Serve the noodles hot with the deep-fried chicken on top.
